title: identity.user.invited.v1
description: A system admin invited an email to a role in a tenant (ADR-030). Published on create and on resend; the previous token is void. yc-message sends the admin_invite link. The envelope actor is the inviting system admin (or the actor from platform.tenant.provisioned.v1 when the first shop admin is auto-invited).

tenant_id.description: _platform for system_admin; an active shop slug for shop_admin (ADR-001).

display_name.description: Optional name suggested at invite time. PII (event-conventions §18).
